name: lamport-proof
description: Convert existing proofs into source-mapped Lamport style and audit them forward or from their conclusion.

interface.shortDescription: Convert and audit structured mathematical proofs
interface.longDescription: Convert an existing proof into a source-mapped Lamport-style hierarchy without filling gaps, audit that hierarchy forward, or trace its conclusion backward as a bounded AND/OR obligation graph. The reverse audit is an independent WWresearch method, not authored or endorsed by Leslie Lamport. Outputs are structured model-assisted reviews, not formal-verification certificates.
defaultPrompt: Convert this proof into source-mapped Lamport style without filling gaps.
Audit this Lamport-style proof forward for scope and validity.
Trace this proof backward as a bounded obligation graph.
